raw.query: WITH target AS (SELECT d.run_id, d.experiment, d.window_name, d.window_requests, d.forecast_model, d.policy, d.quantile, d.is_current, d.superseded_by FROM provenance.v_dim AS d WHERE d.is_current = true AND d.superseded_by IS NULL AND d.run_id IN ('planner:week_fc_p90_toto','planner:week_fc_p90_timesfm')), facts AS (SELECT t.*, l.p99_ms AS ttft_p99_ms, l.n_requests AS effective_requests, (l.p99_ms <= 1000.0) AS ttft_pass, c.gpu_hours, c.provisioned_worker_seconds, cr.denominator_kind, cr.denominator_worker_seconds, cr.cost_ratio, cr.denominator_window_mismatch FROM target AS t JOIN provenance.v_pool_latency AS l ON l.run_id=t.run_id AND l.is_current=true AND l.sla_metric='ttft' JOIN provenance.v_pool_cost AS c ON c.run_id=t.run_id AND c.is_current=true LEFT JOIN provenance.v_cost_ratio AS cr ON cr.run_id=t.run_id AND cr.is_current=true) SELECT run_id, experiment, window_name, window_requests, effective_requests, forecast_model, policy, quantile, is_current, superseded_by, ttft_p99_ms, ttft_pass, gpu_hours, provisioned_worker_seconds, denominator_kind, denominator_worker_seconds, cost_ratio, denominator_window_mismatch FROM facts ORDER BY forecast_model
